passages.actor_quote: Co-Authored by: Rep. Timothy Wesco, Rep. Wes Culver, Rep. Rhonda Rhoads, Rep. Robert Heaton, Rep. Don Lehe, Rep. Matthew Lehman, Rep. Randall Frye.

rows.reasoning: Lehman co-authored HJR 3 (2014) and voted Yea on its House third reading (Yea 57 Nay 40 Excused 3 Not Voting 0), a single-subject constitutional amendment whose operative section reads "Only a marriage between one (1) man and one (1) woman shall be valid or recognized as a marriage in Indiana." That text meets both clauses of the rung "Make same-sex marriage illegal and define marriage as only between one man and one woman": it defines marriage as one man and one woman and bars recognizing any other marriage as a marriage in the state. The engrossed text is silent on civil unions but does bar recognition, which the annex places on this rung rather than on "Recognize civil unions for same-sex couples, but reserve marriage for opposite-sex couples."
